target: 541 Commissio Simplex

source: 541 Simple Entrustment
target: 541 Commissio Simplex

source: How did my reputation spread so quickly?
target: Quomodo fama mea tam celeriter pervagata est?

source: Even if the rumor of me hunting Burman arrived in Port Santa two days before the Flying Bird, the entrustee would have to take time to determine where I live, the authenticity of the news…
target: Etiam si rumor de me Burman venaturum in Port Santa duobus diebus ante Aves Volantes pervenisset, commissarius tempus capere oporteret ut determinaret ubi habitarem atque veracitatem nuntii.

source: Lumian estimated a few days before someone sought his services, and this led his thoughts to the unnatural ‘Madame.’
target: Lumian aestimavit paucis diebus antequam aliquis eius officia petisset, et hoc animos eius ad Dominam insolitam duxit.

source: He stood up and said to Lugano, “Invite that Madame in.”
target: Surgens, dixit ad Lugano: “Illam Dominam intus invita.”

source: With those words, Lumian stooped to pick up the distinctive golden straw hat from the small round table.
target: Verbis illis, Lumian se inclinavit ad tollendum pileum stramineum aureum, distinctum, ex parva mensa rotunda.

source: He aimed to make Louis Berry’s image more memorable, adding a touch of flair to his persona.
target: Scopum habebat ut imaginem Ludovici Berry magis memorabilem redderet, addens aliquod decus ad personam eius.

source: In no time, Lugano escorted a woman in her thirties into the room.
target: Mox, Lugano mulierem in annis tricenariis aetatis in conclave comitavit.

source: She wore a loose-fitting white dress adorned with red flowers, accentuating her curves.
target: Induta erat veste alba soluta, ornata floribus rubris, quae eius lineamenta illustrabat.

source: Port Santa’s women, in contrast to the Dariège region just across the mountain, favored glamorous and stylish attire, embodying a romantic and liberated aesthetic—reflecting the traditional taste of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
target: Mulieres Porti Santae, contra regionem Dariège trans montem, amabant vestimenta decora et elegans, quae aestheticam romanticam et liberatam efferebant, repraesentantes gustum traditionalem Regni Feynapotter.

source: The lady, with long brown hair tied up and a healthy complexion, entered without a maid.
target: Domina, cum capillis longis brunneis alligatis et facie sana, sine ancilla intravit.

source: Her azure eyes, framed by thick eyelashes, focused on Lumian, who held the golden straw hat.
target: Oculi eius caerulei, ciliaribus crassissimis ornati, in Lumian spectabant, qui pileum stramineum aureum tenebat.

source: Her red lips moved, and though Lumian couldn’t grasp every word, the name “Louis Berry” was discernible in her pronunciation.
target: Labia eius rubra moveruntur, et quamquam Lumian non singula verba capere potuit, nomen “Louis Berry” in eius dictione perceptum erat.

source: Promptly, Lugano initiated the translation.
target: Celeriter, Lugano translationem incepit.

source: “The Madame says, Honorable Monsieur Louis Berry, I’ve heard about your hunt of the Demon Warlock. I wonder if you’re willing to help my family solve a problem.”
target: “Domina dicit: ‘Honorabile Domine Louis Berry, audivi de tua venatione Daemoni Incantatoris. Miror num paratus sis auxilium ferre familiae meae ad quaestionem solvendam.’”

source: Lumian’s gaze shifted from the jeweled bead bracelet on the lady’s wrist to her beautiful and mature face.
target: Aspectus Luminum a armilla gemmata in manu dominae ad faciem eius pulchram et maturam migravit.

source: “What’s your name?”
target: “Quod nomen tibi est?”

source: “Giorgia,” the lady replied after Lugano translated.
target: “Giorgia,” respondit domina postquam Lugano interpretatus est.

source: Lumian repeated, acknowledging the lady’s name with a smile,
target: Lumian iteravit, nomen dominae cum risu agnoscens,

source: “Madame Giorgia, what would you like to entrust me with?”
target: “Domina Giorgia, quid vis mihi committendum?”

source: Giorgia listened attentively to Lugano’s translation and spoke in Highlander with a slight local accent, “An evil creature has appeared in my household. I need your help eliminating it.”
target: Giorgia attente auscultavit translationem Lugani et in lingua Highlandensis leviter cum accentu locali locuta est: “Creatura mala in domo mea apparuit. Auxilium tuum ad eam exstirpandam mihi opus est.”

source: Lumian, though grasping the gist, awaited Lugano’s translation by casting his gaze at him.
target: Lumian, licet rem caperet, translationem Lugani exspectabat, eum intuens.

source: When Lugano conveyed Giorgia’s words in Intisian, Lumian chuckled and said, “I’m sorry, I forgot to invite the beautiful Madame to have a seat.
target: Cum Lugano verba Giorgiae in Intisian tradidisset, Lumian subridens dixit: “Ignosce mihi, oblitus sum invitare pulcherrimam Dominam ut sedere possit.”

source: “The great adventurer Gehrman Sparrow taught us that manners are very important.”
target: “Magnus peragrator Gehrman Sparrow nos docuit modos valde esse magni momenti.”

source: Gesturing toward the sofa, Lumian settled onto the divan, attempting to caress Ludwig’s head, like a godfather.
target: Gestu ad sofam indicato, Lumian in divano sede fecit, conans caput Ludovigi teneriter tractare, quasi patrinus.

source: Ludwig quickly shifted his position, avoiding Lumian’s attempt to treat him as a child.
target: Ludwig celeriter suam positionem mutavit, vitans Luminum eum tamquam puerum tractare.

source: As Giorgia took her place in an armchair, Lumian, shaking his golden straw hat, leaned forward.
target: Dum Giorgia in sella sedebat, Lumian, pileum aureum stramineum concutiente, se inclinavit in ante.

source: “Since it’s an evil creature, why don’t you just find a clergyman of the Earth Mother Church to handle it?”
target: “Quoniam creatura mala est, cur non quaeris sacerdotem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae ad eam curandam?”

source: Giorgia looked at Lugano and listened attentively.
target: Giorgia ad Lugano aspexit et attente audivit.

source: She pursed her thick lips and replied in Highlander,
target: Labia eius crassa contraxit, et in lingua Highlandensis respondit,

source: “We don’t want the Church to know about this. It will damage our family’s reputation.”
target: “Nolumus Ecclesiam de hoc agnoscere; nam famae familiae nostrae nocet.”

source: Is that why you are entrusting me, a foreigner who will leave after watching the sea prayer ritual? And that’s after confirming my ability to deal with that evil creature…
target: Num idcirco me committis, peregrinus, qui post ritum orationis maritimae discessurus es? Et hoc, postquam facultatem meam ad illam creaturam malam superandam comprobas?

source: Lumian, pondering this choice, shifted his gaze away from Lugano.
target: Lumian, haec considerans, oculos suos a Lugano avertit.

source: After a brief pause, he inquired, “Tell me more about that evil creature.”
target: Post breve mora, interrogavit: “Dic mihi plura de illa creatura mala.”

source: After a brief pause, Giorgia contemplated and then shared, “It resembles a tailless lizard.
target: Post breve mora, Giorgia meditata, dixit: “Similis est lacertae sine cauda.”

source: It attacked everyone in the household, killing a few maids and valets and devoured their bodies.
target: Omnes in domo aggressus est, paucos ancillas et valetos necans, corpora eorum devoravit.

source: Our family’s bodyguards fired on it and injured it, but they failed to kill it because it has very strong scales.
target: Custodes corporis familiae nostrae in eam telis iacuerunt et vulneraverunt eam, sed interficere non potuerunt, quoniam squamae eius valde robustae sunt.

source: We could only chase it to the basement and lock it up.
target: Illam solum ad cellam subterraneam insequi potuimus et clauserimus.

source: We thought it would slowly starve to death from hunger and thirst.
target: Putavimus eam paulatim fame et sitim morituram iri.

source: To our surprise, nearly two weeks later, it’s still alive and trying to break open the basement door.
target: Ad nostram admirationem, fere post duas septimanas, adhuc vivit et ianuam cellae subterraneae aperire conatur.

source: It doesn’t seem very dangerous.
target: Illa non videtur valde periculosa esse.

source: They could repel it with ordinary firearms…
target: Illam armis ordinariis repelli poterant.

source: They didn’t mention why the lizard appeared.
target: Non narraverunt cur lacerta apparuerit.

source: It appears that this is why they aren’t willing to seek out the Church of Earth Mother and the local government to handle it…
target: Videtur hoc esse quod ideo non volunt Ecclesiam Matris Terrae et regimen locale quaerere ad hoc tractandum.

source: Lumian thoughtfully compared the few words he understood to the content translated by Lugano and confirmed that the guide hadn’t embellished or redacted any content.
target: Lumian, diligentissime meditans, pauca verba quae intellexit cum contento a Lugano translato comparavit et confirmavit ut in translatione nihil additum aut subtractum fuisset.

source: Lumian then casually inquired, “Were there any casualties among the bodyguards?”
target: Lumian deinde leviter interrogavit: “Fueruntne inter custodes familiae nostrae quaedam laesiones?”

source: Giorgia, after the translation, shook her head slowly.
target: Giorgia, post translationem, lente caput concussit.

source: “No fatalities. Two were injured, but nothing severe. Yes, that monster made the entire room feel like it had been dragged into the deep sea, affecting normal movements.”
target: Nullae fatalitates. Duo vulnerati sunt, sed nihil grave. Ita, ille monstrum totum conclave effecit ut quasi in altum mare trahiturus esset, motus normales afficiens.

source: As if dragged into the deep sea… There’s indeed certain Beyonder phenomena, but it seems relatively weak… Deep sea… Lumian’s interest was piqued as he earnestly inquired about the details.
target: Velut quasi in altum mare trahiturus esset… Vere sunt quaedam phaenomena Beyonder, sed videntur relative debilia… Mare profundum… Intererat Luminum, qui ardenter de singulis quaesivit.

source: After a series of responses, Giorgia said gently, “Monsieur Louis Berry, we’re willing to pay you 15,000 risot, but you have to promise not to publicize this matter.”
target: Post seriem responsionum, Giorgia leniter dixit: “Domine Louis Berry, parati sumus tibi 15,000 risot solvere, sed promittendum est ut hanc rem non publices.”

source: 15,000 gold risot? According to your description, the monster is worth at most 5,000 gold risot. The remaining 10,000 should be a hush money, right?
target: 15,000 risot aurei? Secundum descriptionem tuam, monstrum valere potest ad non plus quam 5,000 risot aureos. Reliqua 10,000 debent esse pecunia tacita, nonne?

source: Lumian smiled and said in broken Highlander, “Sure thing.”
target: Lumian subridens dixit in lingua Highlander disrupta: “Certe.”

source: Rising from his seat, Lumian announced in Intisian, “I want to observe the situation at the scene.”
target: Surgens a sede, Lumian in Intisian annunciavit: “Volo statum rerum in situ observare.”

source: Giorgia stood up and listened to Lugano’s translation.
target: Giorgia surrexit et translationem Lugani auscultavit.

source: She wasn’t surprised by Louis Berry’s request.
target: Giorgia non mirata est de petitione Ludovici Berry.

source: Familiar with adventurers and bounty hunters, she understood the importance of assessing the situation firsthand and making thorough preparations.
target: Experta in adventoribus et venatoribus praemiorum, intellexit momentum conditionem directe inspiciendi et praeparationes diligenter faciendas esse.

source: It meant survivability or success for the elites.
target: Hoc significabat vel salutem vel prosperitatem pro electis.

source: “Now?” Giorgia sought confirmation.
target: “Nunc?” quaesivit Giorgia.

source: Lumian comprehended the word and affirmed in Highlander, “Now.”
target: Lumian verbum intellexit et in lingua Highlander affirmavit: “Nunc.”

source: Adorning his golden straw hat, he made his way to the door, supplementing in Intisian, “Also, prepare a sumptuous dinner for me, my godson, and my translator.”
target: Indutus pileo stramineo aureo suo distinctivo et manum Ludovigi tenens, Lumian ad ianuam accessit, addens in Intisian: “Praeterea, parate cenam opulentam mihi, padrino meo, et interpreti meo.”

source: Giorgia, slightly taken aback by the translation, watched Lumian’s departure.
target: Giorgia, translatione paulo obstupescens, discessionem Lumiani observavit.

source: She couldn’t shake the feeling that this adventurer possessed a distinct quality compared to those she had encountered before.
target: Non potuit disicere sensum quod hic peragrator indole distinctus esset comparatus ad eos quos antea convenerat.

source: Port Santa, Saint Lana Street.
target: Port Santa, Via Sanctae Lanae.

source: To the northeast of the city stood multi‐story villas adorned with gardens, lawns, and stables.
target: Ad septentrionem urbis steterunt villae pluristratificatae, ornatae hortis, pratellis, et stabulis.

source: Giorgia’s residence occupied number 21 on this street.
target: Domus Giorgiae numerum 21 in hac via occupabat.

source: The five‐story villa boasted brownish‐red outer walls, adorned with statues of Angels and Saintesses from the Earth Mother Church, along with symbols depicting waves and fishing.
target: Villa quinque stratorum parietes exteriores rubro-brunneos habebat, ornatos statuis Angelorum et Sanctorum de Ecclesia Matris Terrae, simul cum symbolis fluctuum et piscandi.

source: Wearing his distinctive golden straw hat and holding Ludwig’s hand, the latter carrying a red school bag, Lumian trailed behind Giorgia, accompanied by her maid and valet.
target: Indutus pileo stramineo aureo suo distinctivo et manum Ludovigi tenens, qui sacculum scholasticum rubrum gerebat, Lumian post Giorgia secutus est, comitatus ancilla eius et servo.

source: Together, they entered the villa’s hall, which also served as a spacious dance floor beneath a tall, dome ceiling.
target: Simul intraverunt atrium villae, qui etiam spatiosum saltatorium sub tecto cupulato constituebatur.

source: As Lumian stepped inside, he felt unseen eyes upon him from the circular railings on the upper floors.
target: Cum Lumian introit, sensit oculos invisos eum inspicientes a balustradibus circularibus in tabulatis superioribus.

source: It’s indeed a household with multiple families sharing one roof. There are quite a few people…
target: Vere est domus cum plurimis familiis sub uno tecto. Multi homines adsunt…

source: Lumian mused, choosing not to look up, smiling inwardly.
target: Lumian meditatus est, nolens sursum intuere, intus subridens.

source: The concealed observers remained hidden.
target: Observatores absconditi manserunt.

source: Giorgia then summoned two legally armed bodyguards, leading Lumian and the entourage down to the second basement where the iron-black door stood tightly shut.
target: Giorgia deinde duos custodes corporis legaliter armatos convocavit, qui Luminum et comitatus duxerunt ad cellam subterraneam secundam, ubi ianua ferrea atra strenue clausum stabat.

source: As if sensing someone approaching, the door slammed as if struck by a powerful force.
target: Quasi aliquem appropinquare sentiens, ianua subito, quasi vi potentissima icta, clauserit.

source: “It’s inside,” Giorgia stated, pointing at the iron door with a complicated expression.
target: “Intus est,” inquit Giorgia, ianuam ferream ostendens vultu perplexo.

source: Lumian, understanding without the need for translation, pressed down on his golden straw hat and directed, “Take my godson to the living room for pre-dinner dessert.”
target: Lumian, intellegens sine translatione indigeo, pileum aureum stramineum deprimens, dixit: “Ducite padrinum meum in conclave ad praecenam.”

source: As he spoke, he strode towards the subterranean iron door without a backward glance.
target: Dum loquebatur, profectus est versus ianuam ferream subterraneam sine retrospectu.

source: Upon hearing Lugano’s translation, Giorgia and the maid hastily guided Ludwig back to the surface.
target: Ex audita translatione Lugani, Giorgia et ancilla celeriter Ludovigum ad superficiem duxerunt.

source: A bodyguard caught up to Lumian, his expression serious, and handed him a pewter-black key.
target: Unus custos corporis, qui Luminum adsecutus est, vultu serio, clavem nigrum dedit.

source: Without delay, the two bodyguards drew their revolvers, positioning themselves to aim at the iron door, preventing the monster from escaping.
target: Sine mora, duo custodes corporis arma revolutoria eduxerunt, se ordinantes ad ianuam ferream intendere, ne monstrum effugeret.

source: Lumian methodically inserted the key into the lock, unlocking it.
target: Lumian clavem methodice in serram inseruit, eam aperiens.

source: He tossed the key aside and effortlessly pushed the iron door open with one hand.
target: Clavem abiecit et sine labore una manu ianuam ferream aperuit.

source: In an instant, the monster’s figure came into view.
target: In momento, figura monstri apparuit.

source: A humanoid lizard, adorned with glistening, robust scales, met Lumian’s eyes.
target: Lacerta humanoidea, squamis nitidis et robustis ornata, oculos Luminum occurrit.

source: Where there were no scales, smooth, sinister snake-like skin was exposed.
target: Ubi squamae defuebant, cutis levis et sinistra, serpentiformis patebat.

source: The monster’s eyes were vertical, and they glowed with a nearly transparent light.
target: Oculi monstri erant verticales, et luce paene perspicua fulgebant.

source: Its mouth harbored sharp teeth that formed a menacing vortex.
target: Os eius dentes acutos continebat, qui minacem vorticem efficiebant.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian felt the air around him grow dense, like shackles enveloping him, clearly impeding his normal movements.
target: Simul, Lumian sensit aerem circa se densum fieri, quasi vincula eum amplectens, motus naturales eius impedientes.

source: The moisture gave the sensation of plunging into the deep sea, enduring pressure from all directions.
target: Umor dabat sensum quasi in mare profundo immergendi, pressuram ex omnibus partibus ferens.

source: The humanoid lizard lunged forward, and Lumian’s body leaned towards the enemy as if pulled by a vortex.
target: Lacerta humanoidea impetum fecit, et corpus Luminum adversō inclinatum est, quasi a vortice tractum.

source: Yet, the obvious smile on his lips persisted as he calmly attempted to pivot.
target: Tamen, risus evidens in labris eius perseverabat, dum tranquille conabatur se convertere.

source: Suddenly, a latent power surged within him, allowing him to break free from the air’s constraints.
target: Subito, vis latens in eo erupit, quae ei permisit a vinculis aeris se liberare.

source: Lumian swiftly rotated his body, swinging his right fist from below.
target: Lumian celeriter corpus suum rotavit, dextram pugnus ex deorsum ferens.

source: Instantly, crimson flames, nearly white, ignited from his fist, spreading to his forearm, resembling a dazzling fire serpent.
target: Statim, flammae rubrae, paene albae, ex pugno eius incensae sunt, in brachium diffundentes, instar serpentis ignis fulgurantis.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: The punch struck the humanoid lizard’s chest and abdomen, causing the flames to compress.
target: Pugno, lacertae humanoidae pectus et abdominum percussi sunt, unde flammae comprimuntur.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: The humanoid lizard was sent flying, crystalline scales splattering from its chest and abdomen, resulting in a massive wound.
target: Lacerta humanoidea in aera proiecta est, squamae crystallinae ex pectore et abdomine eius dispersae sunt, ingens vulnera relicta.

source: Lumian didn’t give chase. With one hand in his pocket, he changed his right fist to a palm and gently pushed forward.
target: Lumian insequi non instituit. Una manu in marsupio posita, dextram pugnus in palmam mutavit et leniter impulit.

source: Crimson, nearly white fireballs materialized before him, whistling into the wound on the lizard’s chest and abdomen.
target: Globuli ignis rubri, paene albi, coram eo apparuerunt, in vulnera pectoris et abdominis lacertae sibilantes.

source: Rumble!
target: Rumble!

source: The monster disintegrated, its flesh and blood splattering across the ground.
target: Monstrum dissolutum est, et caro atque sanguis eius per terram dispersae sunt.

source: Lumian observed for a few moments before adjusting his golden straw hat.
target: Lumian pauca momenta observavit, deinde pileum aureum stramineum suum rectavit.

source: He turned around and walked towards the stairs leading to the surface.
target: Se vertit et ambulavit ad scalas quae ad superficiem ducunt.

source: The two armed and vigilant bodyguards maintained their original posture, still in a daze, unable to comprehend what had transpired.
target: Duo custodes armati et vigilantissimi statum proprium retinuerunt, adhuc attoniti, non intellegentes quid accidisset.

source: Lumian didn’t “rouse” them as he ascended the stairs.
target: Lumian eos non excitavit dum scalas ascendebat.

source: Upon hearing the explosion, Giorgia, on the ground, left the lounge with Lugano and approached the staircase.
target: Audita explosione, Giorgia in terra, ex conclavi cum Lugano discessit et ad scalas accessit.

source: She saw Lumian coming up.
target: Vidit Lumian ascendere.

source: “Have you confirmed the situation?” Madame Giorgia asked with concern.
target: “Num rem confirmavisti?” inquit Domina Giorgia cum sollicitudine.

source: Lumian replied with a smirk, “It’s resolved.”
target: Lumian subridens respondit: “Res soluta est.”
